notes.title: YOUR VOICE MATTERS
notes.content:
Hey There Agents!

A huge thank you to everyone who’s jumped into the demo already.
YOUR support means everything.
This project has been built with care, creativity, and ambition, and now it's YOUR turn to experience it.

This isn't just a sneak peek - it's a real taste of what’s coming.

I believe in this game, and I’m proud of what’s here. But I’m not done - not even close.

YOUR feedback plays a massive role in shaping what comes next. I’m actively listening - not just collecting comments, but truly paying attention to what you say.
Whether it’s gameplay feel, thoughts, bugs, balance or wild ideas - I want to hear it.

Drop YOUR feedback, ask questions, share your impressions.

The discussions tab is open, the comments are YOURS - and I'm here, listening.

This is a collaboration between a creator and a community.
Thanks for being part of it.

– Afek
Galactic Agent in Chief

notes.title: Demo Is Coming to Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello Galactic Agents

I’ve got some exciting news to share — demo will be live during the Steam Next Fest this June!
I’ve been working hard behind the scenes to bring you a polished, action-packed slice of the game, and I can’t wait for you all to finally try it out!

Mark your calendars: Steam Next Fest kicks off on June 9th, and that’s when the demo drops!


 Step into the chaotic galaxy of contract elimination

 Experience intense, fast-paced bullet-hell action

 Take on one of the galaxy’s deadliest contracts

 Get a first glimpse of your growing galactic arsenal

 Uncover hidden galactic surprises we won’t spoil - you’ll have to find them yourself


REMEMBER: demo is just the beginning of what’s to come.


I'm really looking to hear your thoughts and feedback once you’ve played. It means the galaxy and helps shape the final game.

In the meantime, be sure to wishlist and follow if you haven’t already — and spread the galaxy to your fellow agents!


> Demo Gameplay Screenshot For The Meanwhile

– Afek
Galactic Agent in Chief

notes.title: Welcome to the Galactic Pawns Community
notes.content:
AGENT
Welcome to the official hub of Galactic Pawns.
You’ve just stepped into a universe where contracts are signed in plasma, and failure isn’t an option.

WHO ARE YOU?

You are a destined top-tier galactic operative, dispatched to hostile worlds to eliminate high-profile alien threats. Each mission is a test of skill, strategy, and survival. The contracts are ruthless, the enemies relentless—but failure is not an option.

Upgrade your skills, test a variety of weapons, and uncover ancient magical runes to enhance your abilities. Adapt, evolve, and become the ultimate agent.
Blend in, strike fast, and vanish without a trace. The fate of the galaxy is in your hands.

Are you ready to restore order from the shadows?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45529784/9cc924a01cc854eef1973f94938c8cc25397e510.png

WHAT IS GALACTIC PAWNS?

A fast-paced, top-down action bullet-hell roguelite where you, a galactic agent, are sent across the stars to eliminate high-value targets on hostile planets. Cute visuals mask a deadly mission—precision, reflexes, and adaptability are your only allies.


WHAT IS THIS?

This is your communications channel.
Your signal relay back to HQ.
Use it to ask questions, share feedback, or report anything worth logging.

I’ll be monitoring the channel.
Feel free to reach out—For real, I’m here for it.



–Command out.
